findings.note: U+202F before ':' and ';' per fr style guide; ’ apostrophes; 'vérification'/'vérifié' for screening, 'modération', 'propriétaire', 'remis/remise' for delivery consistent across all 13. 'sa modération' keeps recipient-side scope; base 'refused' variant drops the possessive, matching en.
'analizar/análisis' for screening, 'moderación', 'propietario' (namespace-consistent, 28 uses), 'entregar' for delivery; hedge 'parecía' preserved; ellipsis kept on held.
Full-width （） around {owner}, ：；。; '审核' for moderation, '检查' for screening, '所有者' (namespace-consistent), '智能体' per glossary; hedge '看起来像是' preserved; '……' on held.

'модерация', 'проверка' for screening, 'владелец', 'агенту {agent}' dative keeps {agent} uninflected; 'отклонено его модерацией' recipient-side; hedge 'похоже на' preserved; ё in 'Отклонённое', 'ещё'.
'bộ kiểm duyệt' (moderation), 'sàng lọc' (screening), 'chủ sở hữu', 'tác nhân' per glossary; 'của họ' = their (recipient side); hedge 'có vẻ là' preserved.

RTL: logical-order storage, no manual bidi controls (verified: no Cf/Zs specials); Urdu punctuation ۔ and ؛ used, ellipsis … kept; Latin ( ) and ':' around placeholders are acceptable LTR-island neighbours under render FSI/PDI isolation. آپ-register not needed (no address); 'ماڈریشن', 'جانچ', 'مالک', 'ایجنٹ' per glossary; hedge 'جیسا لگا' preserved; 'ان کی ماڈریشن' recipient-side.

'मॉडरेशन', 'जाँच', 'मालिक' (majority namespace term: 28 vs 3 'स्वामी' in pre-existing non-delta keys), 'एजेंट' per glossary; Hindi danda । full stops; hedge 'जैसा लगा' preserved; 'उनके मॉडरेशन' recipient-side.
Observation outside the PR delta: pre-existing main keys use 'स्वामी' for owner (3 values) while the namespace majority and this delta use 'मालिक'. Not a defect of #1521; not counted.
